options.name: About the Server Guide
description: **Welcome to the Server Guide**
This is your server's built-in guide, powered by the Imperial Codex.
The Server Guide is a navigable information system that helps members find answers about your server quickly.
**How it works:**
- Mention or reply to the bot and ask a question
- Use keywords to find matching guide pages
- Navigate using the buttons and menus below each response
This guide was automatically created with default pages. Your server admins can customize it to fit your community.

options.name: Customizing Your Guide
description: **Guide Customization**
A guide editor is a planned feature that will allow server admins to create, edit, and organize guide pages directly from Discord.
**Planned capabilities:**
- Add and remove guide pages
- Edit page content
- Organize pages into categories
- Link pages to specific channels
Stay tuned for updates on this feature.

name: Server Info
meta_description: Learn about the server and community

options.name: Community Overview
description: **Your Community**
This is where you can describe your server to new and existing members.
**Example topics to cover:**
- What your server is about
- What makes your community unique
- Links to important channels
This page is a direct embed inside a top-level menu. Simple and effective for quick info.

options.name: Available Roles
description: **Server Roles**
This page is inside a nested menu. The user selected a category first, then picked this page.
Use this structure when a topic has multiple related pages that belong under one group.
**Example:**
- Notification roles
- Color roles
- Region roles
Organize your roles info here so members can find what they need.

options.name: Channel Guide
description: **Channel Guide**
Another page inside the same nested menu.
Use pages like this to explain what each channel or category in your server is for.
**Tip:** You can link directly to channels using Discord's channel mention format.
Example: Head to #general to start chatting.

name: Guide Structure
meta_description: See how deep guide menus can go

options.name: Topic Details
options.meta_description: Detailed info on a specific topic

options.name: Deep Dive
description: **You found the deep end!**
This page is nested three levels deep, but it can go deeper if needed:
Guide Structure > Topics > Topic Details > Deep Dive
Menus can go as deep as you need them to. Each level adds a select menu that lets you drill down further into a topic.
**Use deeper nesting for:**
- Large servers with lots of info to organize
- Command references with many categories
- Detailed guides that cover a topic step by step
Keep in mind that simpler is usually better. Only go deep when the content calls for it.

options.name: How Menus Work
description: **Understanding Menu Types**
There are two types of items in the guide:
**Embeds** (type: embed)
- A page that displays content directly
- Contains a title, description, and optional thumbnail
**Selects** (type: select)
- A menu that contains other items
- Can hold embeds, other selects, or a mix of both
- Creates a dropdown for the user to pick from
By combining these two types, you can build a guide as simple or as detailed as your server needs.
